$comment: Scheduled posting (flag post-schedule, D310 proposed). Each auto-queued YouTube upload goes up private with status.publishAt = the next free slot: max(latest future scheduled publish time on the channel, latest slot Ujwalam already gave out) + intervalHours, but never earlier than now + minLeadHours + marginMinutes (with nothing scheduled the first clip gets exactly that). Before an upload session starts or resumes, the slot must still be at least minLeadHours ahead; before every chunk, at least marginMinutes ahead. Otherwise the upload stops and the clip gets a new slot (an unfinished upload session is dropped; Google discards it). The channel read covers at most maxPages x pageSize newest uploads; if the channel has more, nothing is scheduled (fail closed) until maxPages is raised. Read by services/posting/schedule.mjs; never hardcoded. YouTube Data API quota: 1 unit per channels.list, playlistItems.list and videos.list call (1 + 2 per page).
source: intervalHours: user request 2026-11-09 ('post 6 hours ahead of the last scheduled post'). minLeadHours, marginMinutes, maxPages, pageSize: agent default 2026-11-09, not a user instruction; tune here.
